clues.title: Nearly ten
clues.body: Wilco, 09:59, eyes on the wall clock: 'nearly ten, good.' Good for whom? The bank opened at nine.

clues.title: Take ten, Joe
clues.body: A guard sent on break at one minute to ten. The manager took the door himself. A manager who wants the door.

clues.title: Dead line
clues.body: The counter phone has been dead since Alice opened up. Nobody has rung an engineer.

clues.title: Checking the weather
clues.body: Bernard counted Wilco to the front door three times before ten. It isn't raining.

clues.title: Three for one
clues.body: Three guards for a branch this size. Margaret thinks someone is expecting trouble. Or expecting to look like they did.

clues.title: Monday
clues.body: Audit Monday. Wilco has been in at six every day this week. What takes a week to tidy?

clues.title: Locker
clues.body: Sidearms locked away today on the manager's say so. Insurance, apparently. Just for today.

clues.title: The card
clues.body: The staff keycard went on the counter the second they asked for it. They knew there would be one.

clues.title: Stand down
clues.body: Wilco ordered all three guards to stand down before anyone told him to. Three names, no hesitation.

clues.title: Five
clues.body: Five came in. Margaret counted. Five inside. Anyone else is outside, or was already here.

clues.title: Our friend
clues.body: Vander: 'our friend says the back's clear.' A friend who knows the back of this bank.

clues.title: Nine years
clues.body: Tom: a red button in security, straight to the station, nobody's pressed it in nine years. Still wired?

clues.title: One way
clues.body: Harry's orders: nobody goes back through the staff door. Whoever is behind us is meant to stay behind.

clues.title: The man
clues.body: Larry holds the side door 'till the man comes through'. Not the boss. A man.

clues.title: Gone
clues.body: Wilco was in the corridor with us. Then he wasn't. Larry says nobody came through. Vander says 'hmph'.

clues.title: Phone friend
clues.body: Tarry: the job was set up over months by someone inside. Vander only knows him as a voice on a phone.

clues.title: Still live
clues.body: The inside man cut the outside line but would not touch the alarm, it logs. So the red button still works. For now.

clues.title: Never met
clues.body: Vander has never met the man who planned this. He follows a phone. That is not a mastermind.

clues.title: Note to self
clues.body: A guard's note in security: remind Mr Wilco to STOP leaving his office key under the carpet outside his door. Found it again.

clues.title: Five plus one
clues.body: Wilco's notebook. Names, dates, a split. Five ways plus one, and the one is circled.

clues.title: Follow it
clues.body: Dying early teaches nothing. Do what they say. See where they take you.

clues.title: They knew
clues.body: Someone outside was waiting for that side door to open. Waiting, not surprised.

clues.title: From behind
clues.body: Shot on the walkway. I never saw who. Someone who knew I was coming.

clues.title: Not the boss
clues.body: Vander expected the taser. Someone told him what I'd do. He is not the one making the calls. Get to know him.

clues.title: The sixth
clues.body: Mr Wilco. He was waiting outside. He gave the orders. He is the sixth, and he is the man who shoots people on walkways.
